claims: Paul Thomas Anderson's One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards (2026).
One Battle After Another won six awards total at the 98th Academy Awards (2026).
One Battle After Another won Director at the 98th Academy Awards (2026).
One Battle After Another won Adapted Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards (2026).
Ryan Coogler's Sinners led nominations with 16 nods at the 98th Academy Awards (2026).
Sinners broke the record for nominations at the 98th Academy Awards (2026).
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards (2026).
The 10 Best Picture Nominees for the 2026 Oscars are One Battle After Another (Winner), Sinners, Bugonia, F1, Frankenstein, Hamnet, Marty, Supreme, The Secret Agent, Sentimental Value, Train Dreams.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Director for One Battle After Another.
Michael B. Jordan won Actor for Sinners.
Teyana Taylor was nominated for Actress for One Battle After Another.
Fire and Ash received two nominations.
